Container.Name: scrob-omnibus
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media tracking for Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby — your private Letterboxd + Trakt. Omnibus image with embedded PostgreSQL (single container).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: scrob.app jellyfin plex emby trakt letterboxd media tracker
Container.Description:
Scrob syncs your libraries from Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby, tracks watch history, ratings, and personal lists, and supports webhooks, Radarr/Sonarr requests, and Trakt/Simkl integration.
This template uses the official omnibus image (bellamy/scrob:latest-omnibus) — PostgreSQL runs inside the container; no separate database container is required.
HTTPS and PWA install require a reverse proxy (NPM, SWAG, Traefik) in front of port 7330.
Unraid template support: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/199294-support-jorgen-scrob-omnibus/ Scrob application (bugs, features): https://github.com/ellite/scrob/issues

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Data
Config.Description: Embedded PostgreSQL database (required for omnibus mode)

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Required. JWT signing key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (e.g. Australia/Sydney, Europe/Oslo), Use TZ Identifier from: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Enable Registrations
Config.Description: Allow new users to register. Set false after initial setup.
